about.name: Montse Ortiz
bio: I studied international business and ended up writing code. What started as curiosity turned into a career, and I haven't looked back.
Since then I've worked at startups and as a consultant at Xeleva, building interfaces with React and Next.js and, when the project needs it, the backend too.
At Xeleva I also mentor junior developers. Explaining things out loud is the fastest way I know to find out whether I really understand them.
I learn fast: I built a custom WordPress site in a week, and I'd rather say "I don't know this yet" than pretend.
Outside of work I do CrossFit, which is how WOD Tracker was born: I was tired of copying the whiteboard by hand.
